title: WWE Radio Included In $5 Sports Broadcast Package - NewsBreak
text:
By Thomas Lowson ,
43 minutes ago
SiriusXM is launching a new sports package this fall for subscribers that will include the recently announced WWE Radio as part of its service.
READ MORE: Finn Balor And Becky Lynch Appearing For Zuffa Boxing
READ MORE: WWE RAW Sinks To One Of Its Lowest Cagematch Ratings As Fans Slam Show
The package will launch on September 1 and will include all of the satellite radio provider’s sports channels in addition to various regional terrestrial sports radio stations.
The package will cost $5 a month, and the full list of channels includes:
Exclusive SiriusXM Sports Channels
Mad Dog Sports Radio
SiriusXM NFL Radio
MLB Network Radio
SiriusXM NBA Radio
NHL Network Radio
SiriusXM NASCAR Radio
SiriusXM INDYCAR Nation
F1 on SiriusXM
